The '''Admiralty''' was a high ranking branch of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]]. It was the reorganization of its [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiralty (New Republic)|predecessor]], possibly related to [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force Fleet Command|Galactic Alliance Fleet Command]].
